facts.text: The Company reserves the right to disallow or block any Trader from participating in the program for any reason, in the Company’s sole and absolute discretion; several prohibited practices apply as determined by the Company in its sole and absolute discretion.
All-or-nothing style is capped by a $10,000 daily and per-trade gain limit (trades at similar times count as one).
